bulk_description: Each order keeps its validations. Valid changes are applied; failed orders stay selected with their reason.
bulk_multiple_branches: Choose orders from one branch to assign a shared delivery user. Across branches, existing assignments are kept.
bulk_need_courier: Choose a delivery user: some delivery orders are unassigned.
bulk_stock_acknowledge: Confirm these orders despite insufficient inventory
bulk_stock_failed: Could not check inventory. Retry before confirming.
bulk_network_failed: No batch result was received. Refresh the board before retrying.
bulk_limit: You can select up to {{count}} orders.
bulk_next_hint: Each order will advance one step from its current status. Review the changes before confirming.
drag_handle_hint: Drag using the dotted handle, or use Space and the keyboard arrows.
drag_valid_hint: Drop in the highlighted column to advance to the next status.
drag_mixed_hint: Selected orders have different statuses. Use Next status to advance each one by one step.
orders_desc: Manage delivery and external platform orders
orders_module_warning_desc: Enable the "Orders" module in the branch configuration to enable Cluvi and WooCommerce integrations.
status_update_failed: Could not update the order status
stock_warning_desc: These items have no available stock at the branch. You can still confirm: the sale will be recorded with negative inventory.
manual_order_desc: Record a sale taken at the counter or a delivery.
no_branch_items: This branch has no active products assigned.
edit_cancelled: A cancelled or refunded order cannot be edited.
cluvi_details_local_only: Cluvi does not allow updating address or notes through its API (products and status only): changes will be saved in PosCo.
new_order_toast_one: New order from {{platform}} — click to view it
new_order_toast_other: {{count}} new orders from {{platform}} — click to view them
new_order_desktop_body: {{platform}} — open the backoffice to view the order.
create_order_branch_hint: Choose the branch where you want to create the order.
closing_desc: Reconciliation of the branch's current period: resolve orders left open, reconcile how each one was paid and generate the closing. Collection happens outside the POS.
window_hint: From the branch opening time to the next opening.
breakdown: Summary by origin, status and method
closing_empty: The window has no pending orders to close.
deliveries_desc: Assign ready orders to a courier, dispatch them and track what each one carries and has to collect.
deliveries_drag_hint: Drag an order to On the way to dispatch it with its courier.
deliveries_shipped_hint: Mark Delivered once the courier confirms the delivery.
deliveries_assign_today_only: Assignment always shows the active orders of today.
deliveries_route_empty: No orders with a courier on this day.
delivery_dispatch_desc: Choose the courier carrying the order. It will move to On the way.
couriers_desc: Couriers who take orders to customers. They are not system users: they are only assigned to orders.
couriers_search: Search by name, phone or plate…
courier_form_desc: Courier contact details and the branch they serve.
courier_branch_hint: All = can serve orders from any branch.
courier_none_available: There are no active couriers for this branch.
reconcile_err_method: Select the payment method of each line.
reconcile_err_amount: Each amount must be greater than zero.
reconcile_err_sum: Payments must add up to the order total.
reconcile_err_tendered: Cash received cannot be less than the amount.
reconcile_err_reference: This payment method requires a reference.
settlement_hint: Cash to return = reconciled cash of their orders (change was already given to the customer). Shipping is informative.
settlement_empty: No delivery orders in the period.
closing_already_closed: This period is already closed. Orders arriving later move to the next period.
phase2_tendered_error: Tendered cash must cover the total.
phase2_cancelled_on_way: Cluvi cancelled this order in transit. Notify the courier and confirm its return.
phase2_unassigned_late: Ready without a courier for over 15 minutes
phase2_manager_only: Only admins and managers can manage shifts and integrations.
phase2_cash_formula: Cash to return = opening cash + net cash collected. Tips are included in the order total and shown separately.
phase2_webhook_quiet: The store has not received orders for over 2 hours. Check the webhook; this may be a quiet period.
phase2_no_shift: You have no active shift. It opens when you sign in or are assigned an order.
phase2_link_invalid: Invalid or expired link. Ask the store for a new one.
e_no_coordinates: {{count}} orders have no coordinates: check the address in the list.
e_map_pick: Click the map to choose coordinates. Addresses are not automatically geocoded.
e_run_help: Select up to 20 Ready orders. Selection order defines stops; you can reorder them. This is not a calculated road route.
e_zone_help: Circular branch zones. Overlapping zones use highest priority, then smallest radius. Automatic shipping is verified when creating orders; editing a zone never changes previous orders.
e_proof_consent: The recipient authorizes storing this photo or signature as delivery proof.
e_proof_private: Restricted to managers/admins. Not published in the image gallery.
closing_period_closed_desc: This period's closing was already generated and is read-only. Orders arriving later move to the next period.
closing_carried_title_one: {{count}} order from previous periods is still not closed
closing_carried_title_other: {{count}} orders from previous periods are still not closed
closing_carried_desc: They were left open (e.g. the status was never updated). Resolve them here: say whether they were delivered and how they were paid, or whether they were cancelled.
closing_step_resolve_hint: Orders without a final status. They are not closed until you say whether they were delivered or cancelled.
closing_step_reconcile_hint: Record how each delivered order was paid (cash with change, card, transfer or several).
closing_resolve_delivered_desc: Say how it was paid. The sale will be recorded with these payments.
closing_resolve_cancel_desc: Order #{{reference}} ({{total}}) will be cancelled and will not create a sale.
closing_close_summary_one: {{count}} finished order (delivered or cancelled) will be closed · sales {{total}}.
closing_close_summary_other: {{count}} finished orders (delivered or cancelled) will be closed · sales {{total}}.
closing_close_unresolved_warning_one: {{count}} unresolved order is left out and moves to the next period.
closing_close_unresolved_warning_other: {{count}} unresolved orders are left out and move to the next period.
closing_close_unreconciled_warning_one: {{count}} delivered order has no reconciled payments yet.
closing_close_unreconciled_warning_other: {{count}} delivered orders have no reconciled payments yet.
close_confirm_detail_one: {{count}} order ({{total}}) will be closed. It cannot be edited afterwards.
close_confirm_detail_other: {{count}} orders ({{total}}) will be closed. They cannot be edited afterwards.
totals_hint: Declared by the customer vs. reconciled (order count in parentheses).
totals_empty: No amounts in this period yet.
deliveries_search: Search by order, customer, phone or address
deliveries_incidents_title_one: {{count}} order cancelled while on the way
deliveries_incidents_title_other: {{count}} orders cancelled while on the way
deliveries_incidents_desc: Coordinate the return to the store with the courier.
sync_retry_ok: Order status synced with the platform.
sync_retry_failed: Could not sync. Check the branch connection.
order_detail_failed: Could not load the order details.
cluvi_connect_description: Send new orders from this store to POSCO. Keep your existing Cluvi menu.
cluvi_menu_optional: Publishing the POSCO menu is optional and replaces the Cluvi menu. You can keep it to manage existing orders.
cluvi_saved_credentials: Leave credentials empty to keep the saved values.
search_orders_placeholder: Search by order #, customer, phone, address or product…
cancel_order_desc: Select how to process the order items and enter an optional reason.
cancel_restocked_desc: The product was not prepared or returns intact to inventory.
cancel_waste_desc: The product was already prepared or discarded; it does not return to stock.
zone_delete_confirm_desc: Are you sure you want to delete zone "{{name}}"?
quote_simulator_desc: Test which zone and shipping rate apply for coordinates.
quote_no_coverage: No coverage in active zones for these coordinates.
notifications_empty: No recent notifications in this session.
wa_card_desc: Link the branch WhatsApp number via QR and configure automatic events and templates.
wa_enabled_label: Enable WhatsApp notifications for this branch
wa_notify_external_label: Also notify external platform orders (Cluvi / WooCommerce)
wa_qr_expired: QR expired, request a new one
wa_save_before_connect: Save WhatsApp settings before connecting or generating the QR.
wa_channel_not_configured: This branch does not have a WhatsApp channel yet. Click Save WhatsApp settings to create it, then generate the QR.
wa_channel_load_failed: Could not load the WhatsApp channel. Retry before changing its settings.
wa_history_empty: No Evolution API messages sent for this order yet.
wa_resend_confirm_check: I understand the previous message may have been delivered and accept the duplicate risk.
wa_api_description: Review the recipient and template. The message will be sent from the branch number through Evolution API.
wa_unsaved_draft: Unsaved changes. Your draft will be recovered when you return during this session.
wa_leave_unsaved: There are unsaved WhatsApp changes. Leave and keep the draft for later?
wa_discard_confirm: Discard unsaved changes for this branch?
e_map_pick_hint: Tap the map to choose the delivery point or enter coordinates. The address is not automatically converted to a location.
product_search_error: Could not load the catalog. Try again.
order_draft_storage_error: This browser cannot save the draft. Keep the form open until the order is created.
order_draft_recovered: Your unfinished order was recovered. Review it before creating it.
order_draft_discard_confirm: Discard all data for this order?
order_draft_invalid_products: Some products are unavailable or could not be verified. Remove them or retry before creating the order.
order_draft_prices_changed: Catalog prices changed. Update reference prices to review the total; custom prices are preserved.
customer_linked: Customer linked. Address changes apply only to this order; editing the name or phone switches to a one-time customer.
customer_phone_hint: Enter at least 6 digits to find a customer. You can also create a one-time order.
customer_lookup_error: Customer lookup failed. Retry or continue as a one-time customer.
customer_no_matches: No active matches. Continue with this order's details.
customer_refine_phone: More matches found. Enter the full phone number to narrow results.
timeline_available: Available events, newest first. History before auditing was enabled may be missing.
timeline_snapshot: Current incident; order's last update time.
wa_setup_link_hint: Save settings to create the channel, then scan the QR below from Linked Devices in WhatsApp.
wa_setup_verify_hint: Check the current Evolution connection. After scanning the QR, wait a few seconds for confirmation.
wa_setup_verify_error: Could not verify Evolution. Check the connection and retry.
wa_setup_not_connected: Connection is not yet confirmed. Link the number and verify again.
wa_setup_test_hint: Choose an order whose recipient authorized contact. A real order notification is sent only after you review the preview and confirm.
wa_setup_find_order: Find an order by reference or customer
wa_setup_test_accepted: The provider accepted the notification or it has a later receipt. Check history for delivery status.
wa_setup_test_waiting: Waiting for an accepted manual notification from this test. Queued does not mean delivered.
wa_setup_test_check_error: Could not check the result. Review history before sending again.
wa_setup_skip_test: Configure events without sending a test
wa_setup_auto_hint: Select events and review templates below. Enable the channel and save settings when ready.
wa_setup_test_not_done: No accepted test has been recorded in this assistant. You can configure events and test later.
wa_setup_manual_enable_hint: To test a manual notification, enable the channel and save. For a new setup, leave automatic events off until the test is complete.
saved_courier_unavailable_hint: The saved courier is not in the current list. The filter is still applied.
tracking_gps_help: Enable GPS during your shift so dispatch and the customer can follow the delivery. Keep this screen visible: the browser may suspend location when the phone is locked.
tracking_gps_idle: Location capture is stopped on this device.
tracking_gps_pause_pending: Local capture stopped. Server pause is pending.
tracking_gps_unavailable: You need HTTPS and a browser with geolocation to share your location.
tracking_gps_denied_hint: Allow location for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
tracking_gps_network_error: The latest location could not be published. We will retry with a recent fix; offline history will not be uploaded.
tracking_gps_low_accuracy: GPS accuracy is too low. Move to a place with a better signal.
tracking_gps_waiting_hint: A recent position could not be obtained. Check GPS and wait for a new signal.
tracking_gps_start_failed: Location capture could not start. Check your connection and shift.
tracking_session_ended: The session changed or your shift is no longer available. Capture has stopped.
tracking_pause_pending: We could not confirm the pause on the server. Retry; without new samples the location will stop appearing as current.
tracking_existing_session: A location session is active. Starting here replaces the previous session.
tracking_map_legend: Green: courier · Blue: destination/estimated route · Purple: recent trail
tracking_tiles_error: The base map is unavailable. Tracking data is still being updated.
tracking_connection_fallback: Periodic updates active. Retrying live connection…
tracking_internal_error: Tracking could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
tracking_no_couriers: No couriers have an active shift at this branch.
tracking_route_summary: Estimated route: {{minutes}} min · {{km}} km. No real-time traffic.
tracking_route_not_configured: Road-based estimates are not configured yet.
tracking_route_unavailable: The estimated route is currently unavailable.
tracking_route_no_route: No road route was found between these points.
tracking_route_no_destination: The destination has no coordinates for routing.
tracking_route_no_location: An estimated arrival will be available with a recent location during delivery.
tracking_route_other_stops: There are other deliveries on this route. An arrival time is not shown yet.
tracking_public_privacy: This link only shows tracking for your order. Location is removed when the delivery ends or capture is paused.
tracking_unavailable: This tracking link is no longer available. It may have expired or been revoked. Ask the store for a new one.
tracking_public_network_error: Tracking could not be updated. Check your connection and try again.
tracking_link_help: Anyone with this link can view this order until it expires. You can renew or revoke it at any time.
tracking_link_error: The tracking link could not be updated.
tracking_copy_failed: Could not copy the link. Select it and copy it manually.
tracking_renew_confirm: The previous link will stop working. Create a new one?
tracking_revoke_confirm: The customer will lose access through this link. Revoke it?
wa_test_sent: Test message sent to {{phone}}. Check the business WhatsApp.
wa_test_failed: Could not send the test message
wa_phone_not_on_whatsapp: This number is not on WhatsApp
wa_phone_invalid: Invalid number: check the country code
wa_phone_unknown: Could not confirm whether it has WhatsApp
setup_subtitle: Everything a branch needs to start dispatching, in one place.
setup_ready: Done! This branch can now receive and dispatch deliveries.
setup_step_location_hint: Place the store on the map: it centers zones and is the route origin.
setup_step_location_done: The store is placed on the map.
setup_step_zones_hint: Define how far you deliver and how much you charge.
setup_step_zones_done: Active zones are charging shipping automatically.
setup_step_couriers_hint: Create users with the Courier role and an email so they can sign in at /delivery.
setup_step_couriers_done: There are active couriers for this branch.
setup_step_whatsapp_hint: Connect the business WhatsApp to notify customers and couriers.
setup_step_cluvi_hint: Connect your Cluvi store to receive its orders here.
setup_step_woocommerce_hint: Connect your WooCommerce store to receive its orders here.
setup_couriers_desc: Shifts open automatically when a courier signs in or gets their first order. Just create their user with an email and settle their cash at the end of the day.
setup_whatsapp_desc: Connect by scanning a QR code and send yourself a test message to confirm it works.
setup_integrations_desc: Cluvi and WooCommerce are independent: set up the ones you have enabled.
routes_zones_moved: Zones and fees are now configured in
location_desc: Search the address, use your current location or tap the map. You only do this once.
location_pick_hint: Tap the map to move the store point, then save.
location_not_found: We couldn't find that address. Try another one or tap the map.
location_search_failed: Address search failed. Tap the map to place it.
location_gps_unavailable: Couldn't get your location. Check browser permissions.
zones_desc: Each zone is a circle around the store with its shipping fee. If they overlap, the closest one applies.
zones_need_location: Place the branch on the map first: new zones are centered on it.
zones_suggested_desc: Three rings around the store. Enter each fee and create them in one click; you can adjust them later.
zones_test_mode: Test a fee: tap the map at a customer's address
zones_test_hint: Tap where the customer lives to see which zone and fee apply.
zones_pick_hint: Tap the map to move the zone center (defaults to the store).
zones_pick_center: Tap the map to choose the zone center.
cluvi_ops_inactive: There is no active Cluvi integration for this branch.
cluvi_ops_moved_alert: Cluvi needs attention in {{count}} branch(es): orders not arriving, store paused or unlinked products.
shifts_auto_note: Shifts open automatically when a courier signs in or gets their first order, using their last opening cash (you can correct it). You can also start one manually here and settle cash at the end.
tracking_hint_stale: Location isn't updating: ask them to keep the delivery app open.
tracking_hint_waiting: Not sharing yet: ask them to open the app and tap “Share location”.
tracking_hint_paused: They paused their location: ask them to resume it in the app.
tracking_without_shift_hint: They haven't signed in today. Their shift opens automatically when they sign in or get an order.
tracking_access_desc: Share this link: couriers sign in with their email and password and share their location from there.
tracking_access_share: Hi, sign in here with your email and password to see your deliveries and share your location: {{url}}
tracking_not_in_app_hint: hasn't opened the delivery app yet. If it's their first time, they must sign in and change their temporary password, then tap “Share location”.
tracking_hint_not_started: Not sharing yet: ask them to open the app and tap “Share location”.
e_whatsapp_courier_cancelled_message: Hi {{courier}}, order #{{reference}} for {{name}} was cancelled. Coordinate returning it to the store before continuing.
cancellation_type_restocked_desc: Products return to available branch stock. Generates no waste cost.
cancellation_type_waste_desc: Products are discarded as a physical loss and waste cost is recorded in inventory.
cancellation_reason_placeholder: Describe why this order was cancelled...
cancellation_quick_beverages_restocked: Drinks to stock, food to waste
